title: c33 joins: exploration debt, so a new class first: chemically interacting phoretic colloids (Soto-Golestanian / Agudo-Canalejo non-reciprocal mixtures) from a random gas
summary: Particles of two species make or consume one shared chemical and move up or down its gradient; non-reciprocal pairs should self-assemble into coated, self-propelled composites. First loop: a sighting with a no-chemotaxis control.
